notes.title: Weaverse goes to vacation
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!
Unfortunately, Weaverse will be withdrawn from the store soon. The game in need of some improvements, and I need some time to regroup. I am very sorry for any possible inconveniences.
See you soon with renewed and refreshed Weaverse.

notes.title: What To Expect From Our Final Launch
notes.notes:
As some of you may have noticed, we held a Kickstarter for Weaverse and it failed to get funded. The goal of the Kickstarter was to provide voice actors for the characters in the game, expand the maps, add multiplayer, and more. So, without the Kickstarter, what can players expect from Weaverse on launch?

Both the Good News and the Bad News, along with some special details, are discussed in our latest Devlog covering what you can all expect from the final version of Weaverse! Check it out below:

[url=https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverses-future-without-a-kickstarter/]Weaverse’s Future Without A Kickstarter[/url]

notes.title: Update #3: Chapter 2 Added
notes.notes:
As we have said before, the early access for Weaverse is continuing to be improved. However, Yellow Cat-Rabbit is doing more than just fixing the bugs as they are presented. This next update includes an expansion to the game that many have been waiting for. The update that has just gone live includes the entirety of Chapter 2, side missions included!

Check out the full blog on the Odd Branch [url=https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-early-access-gets-an-expansion-update/]website[/url]!

notes.title: Update #2: New Weapon, Patches, and more
notes.notes:
We continue to bring new updates to Weaverse and improve the overall experience during the Early Access just as we promised in our Road Map. We are proud to announce yet another update to the game which includes:
[list]
[*] Bugs fixed
[*] UI improved
[*] New game mechanic introduced (Ice Gun)
[*] Aguruh Map Rebuild and Expantion
[/list]

Be sure to see what changes we have provided in these cases and remember that you can report any bugs or problems to our email: Help@OddBranch.com

[url=https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-gets-a-second-early-access-update/]Full Announcement Here[/url]

notes.title: Update #1: Achievements, New Game Mode and More
notes.notes:
[h1]Thanks to everyone who sent us feedback on how we can improve the game. Based on your feedback, the first update has been released and includes the following changes to the game:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] A whole new game mode for you to enjoy
[*] Lots of bugs fixed
[*] Improvements to the UI (teleport room in particular)
[/list]

[h1]The next major update is expected to be released on 14 June 2019. Make sure to send your suggestions and feedback to help@oddbranch.com.[/h1]

You can read the full announcement on this update on the latest Odd Branch [url=https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-first-early-access-update-is-live/]Devlog here[/url].

notes.title: With Early Access Live, What's Next?
notes.notes:
The first of the good news is that this is merely the beginning of the Early Access version itself! We are planning to launch more stages to the Early Access. These stages and release dates are planned to be as follows:

Stage 1: Achievements added and a new game mode implemented. Expected to be added on June 3rd.

Stage 2: A bigger and better Aguruh map and some bug fixes. Expected to be added on June 14th.

Stage 3: Unlock the 2nd chapter in its entirety. Expected to be added on July 1st.

Final Version: Details retained and surprises expected. Planned to be updated by the end of July.

You can check out the full announcement on our latest Devlog - [url=https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-early-access-is-live-so-whats-next/]https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-early-access-is-live-so-whats-next/[/url]

notes.title: Early Access Delay
notes.notes: We regret to inform you that there will be a short delay as to when the Early Access version will become available. It should still be out early May 2019, so the wait won't be long, but we are unsure as to which date officially. Expect another announcement when we know more!

notes.title: Early Access Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
The official release date for Weaverse Early Access is going to be April 30, 2019. That’s only days away and in this time we are running multiple testers through the build to ensure it is as bug-free and entertaining as possible. The Early Access build will feature the reduced price of $6.99 for those interested in getting your copy as soon as possible. The full game price is still to be determined, but all purchases of Weaverse from April 30th up to launch will go towards funding the projects progress.

The full write up covering the Early Access announcement for Weaverse is in the latest Odd Branch Publishing blog post: [url=https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-steam-early-access-launch-date-is-set/]https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-steam-early-access-launch-date-is-set/[/url]

notes.title: Weaverse Development Update
notes.notes:
It wasn’t too long ago that we originally announced our upcoming sci-fi action title Weaverse and launched a free demo on Steam. Receiving mostly positive feedback, we are excited to see what you all will say once we have completed the game.
So far, we have completed a lot of the level building and coding, leaving us with only so much to share and show off. If you have been following our Twitter or Facebook then you would have seen us show off some new enemies, but what exactly do they each do? Let’s start off this update with a breakdown of the four enemies we have shown you over the past month:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33365300/2d6d0662168b21df4b58a5ed9104d6004a955842.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] D-Key – Not aggressive towards the player. Needs to be escorted to the corresponding Gate to open new passages in the Dark World.
[*] Guardian – A heavy gunner, patrolling dungeons. Will try to destroy player on sight.
[*] Bomber – Usually patrolling dungeons in groups of 3 to 7 Bombers. Will try to get as close to the player as they can and detonate.
[*] Scout – Cannot harm the player but will summon Bombers and/or Guardians if the player exposes themselves to it.
[/list]

[url=https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-development-update/]Read the full article![/url]
